payload.reason: The evidence clearly indicates that among the three pre-training tasks, Sentence Reordering (SR) is the most effective for improving performance in document summarization tasks.

claims.text: Sentence Reordering (SR) is the most effective pre-training task compared to Next Sentence Generation (NSG) and Masked Document Generation (MDG).
Using SR for pre-training leads to significant improvements in ROUGE scores on summarization datasets.
